_template_doc: L0 WRAPPER — fill template for ONE entity-layer wrapper view. Spec: L0_WRAPPER_SPEC.md (same dir). Tier-3 exploratory instrument for Cowork+Pav ratification — NOT canon, NOT a promotion, convergence list stays 9. THE WRAPPER IS A COMPILED VIEW over substrate facts (../canonical_genealogy/substrate/facts/l0_catalog.*.jsonl resolved by compile_substrate.py) — NOT a second source of truth. AUTHORING ORDER: fetch source -> append fact -> recompile -> rebuild this view. Every populated field carries fact_refs to real fact_ids; a field with no backing fact stays EMPTY (empty is correct signal; data-absent = draw nothing). NO fabrication: real fetched source URL or skip. KERNEL admission (spec 2.3): bucket=corroborated AND certainty>=0.7 AND not ESTIMATE/PROXY-tagged — estimates never enter the kernel. MEMBRANE = the fuzzy frontier; facts are micro-wrappers whose membrane hardness = verification bucket x certainty (spec 3, proxy l0-membrane-proxy-v0.1, ALWAYS disclosed as a render proxy). Abstraction ladder = the contextual-scale dial on the semantic axis; dialing a rung is a REFRAME, not a zoom; level may be frame-relative by scope (aspirin genericide pattern). Each array below holds ONE empty exemplar element showing the shape; duplicate or delete as needed.
_wrapper_id_comment: l0:<slug> — kebab slug, stable, unique across the catalog.
_kind_enum: object | device-model | ai-model | person | compound | book | idea | institution | place | work | event — extending requires a PROPOSED entry in SWEEP_LOG.md before first use.
_status: Tier-3 WORKING wrapper view — exploratory, surfaced for Cowork+Pav ratification. NOT canon, NOT a tier promotion, does NOT grow the convergence list (stays 9).

abstraction._comment: The contextual-scale dial (spec 2.2). Ladder edges are COMPILED from rel:instance-of / rel:subclass-of / rel:brand-of facts — no rung without a backing fact. level is derived from ladder position by default; level_by_scope only where scope-suffixed abstraction_level:<scope> facts exist (frame-relative level, e.g. genericide by jurisdiction).

kernel._comment: The certain core — ONLY facts passing the admission rule (bucket=corroborated AND certainty>=0.7 AND no ESTIMATE:/PROXY: tag). Recomputed every sweep; it may shrink — shrinkage is honest signal.

facts._battle_count_comment: number of INDEPENDENT corroborating verification routes — battle-tested = corroborated against independent routes.

membrane._comment: The fuzzy frontier — a population of fact-micro-wrappers at various hardening stages (spec 3). Render per spec 3.1: corroborated_soft/pending fuzzy, disputed under-attack (BOTH values shown), unverifiable soft spot, scars permanent notches. Hardness h = B(bucket) x certainty (l0-membrane-proxy-v0.1) — a RENDER PROXY, disclose wherever drawn.

corroborated_soft.note: corroborated but certainty<0.7 or ESTIMATE/PROXY-tagged — battle-tested model is still a model

scars._comment: retracted per SUBSTRATE gotcha 10 (unverifiable + provenance-failure note + re-sourced successor fact) — demoted, visible, NEVER deleted.

open_questions._candidate_edge_comment: OPTIONAL { type, target, verification_route } — an edge believed but not yet fact-backed lives HERE, never in relations[].

frames._comment: Observer-global-kernel relevance weights {time,space,knowledge,meaning} in [0,1] — drive prominence/layout in group renders (spec 4).
frames._estimate_note: MANDATORY DISCLOSURE: these weights are AUTHORED RENDER ESTIMATES, not measured quantities and not substrate facts. Any toy/viewer rendering them owes an adjacent estimate/proxy disclosure (UI_GUIDELINES 5).

lifecycle._event_comment: kind-appropriate predicate per spec 2.6 table (person: born/died/active_from/active_to; device-model: announced/released/discontinued/superseded_when; ai-model: announced/released/deprecated/trained; compound: first_synthesized/first_marketed/genericized/named; book: written/published/adapted; object: named/emerged/mass_adoption; institution: founded/dissolved). Partial-precision dates allowed — fuzziness goes in the fact's notes + lower certainty, never invented precision.

relations._type_enum: instance-of | subclass-of | brand-of | part-of | made-by | authored-by | about | conceptual-ancestor-of | influenced | enabled | available-on | measures | treats | adapted-into | named-after | successor-of — extend via SWEEP_LOG proposal before use.
relations._target_comment: l0:<slug> for a catalog entity, or proposed:<slug> for a not-yet-cataloged target (which thereby joins the next sweep's frontier).
relations._fact_refs_comment: HARD RULE: >=1 backing fact_id (l0-<slug>-rNNNN; predicate rel:<type>:<target-slug> in facts/l0_catalog.relations.jsonl) or the edge does not belong in relations[] — unbacked candidate edges live in membrane.open_questions.

frame_layer._comment: (D3 shape, reused verbatim from SCHEMA_v2) layer in {physical|latent|straddle}; memberships graded in [0,1]; crisp is the special case (D5).
frame_layer._estimate_note: authored analytic estimate, not a substrate fact

specimen_refs._comment: Convergence path (spec 6) — OPTIONAL cross-ref to a merge-event specimen node this entity is implicitly named by. Lives ONLY on the L0 side; SCHEMA_v2 and the frozen specimens stay untouched.

substrate_binding._namespace_comment: Disjoint namespaces keep compile_substrate.py's HAZARD guard (fatal, exit 2) quiet — never reuse an id across different (specimen, subject_id, predicate) groups; check the existing max NNNN per slug before emitting.
substrate_binding._hand_assembled_comment: true allowed ONLY until the builder lands, and every populated field must still carry real fact_refs; the builder must then reproduce the view byte-for-byte modulo 'generated'.
